topic: Jinbe gave Luffy the transfusion Fisher Tiger refused, a deliberate mirror
title: Jinbe Gave Luffy What Fisher Tiger Refused
description: Fisher Tiger turned down a human's help in chapter 609. Years later Jinbe gave a human captain exactly that gift. Here is why I think Oda built the mirror on purpose. Do you read it as an undone wall or a finished wish?
comment: Did Jinbe undo Fisher Tiger's last choice, or finish his wish? Pick one.

lines.text: Jinbe gave Luffy the one thing Fisher Tiger refused to accept.

shot.fallback: whale shark fish-man beside a sleeping boy in a straw hat

lines.text: And I think Oda built that mirror on purpose.

shot.fallback: fish-man captain and his loyal first mate
tiger shark fish-man on a ship deck

lines.text: Fish-men believed humans left him without help.

shot.fallback: angry fish-man looking at a human ship

lines.text: The truth is that Tiger's transfusion was refused, and he was left to fade.

shot.fallback: weak fish-man captain refusing help from a human

lines.text: Fish-men were left to blame humans.

shot.fallback: fish-man captain looking at the sky

lines.text: Jinbe was a Sun Pirate under Tiger, and he carried that loss.
Now jump to Fish-Man Island, where Luffy collapses after the Hody fight.

shot.fallback: boy in a straw hat lying exhausted

lines.text: The islanders won't help, because their law forbids giving it to a human.
Jinbe volunteers, and he steps up.

shot.fallback: whale shark fish-man rolling up a sleeve

lines.text: His reason is one line: I'm a pirate.

shot.search: Jinbe I am a pirate Luffy

lines.text: Some say that's just a sweet scene.

shot.fallback: fish-man sitting beside a hospital bed

lines.text: But it's the same gift, the same line, and the opposite answer.

shot.fallback: two fish-men mirrored, one refusing, one giving

lines.text: Then Luffy asks him to join, and Jinbe says not yet.

shot.fallback: boy in a straw hat offering a hand to a fish-man

lines.text: He joins as helmsman later, in the Wano arc.

lines.text: Tiger's wish finally has a captain.

lines.text: And that's why, in the end, Jinbe gave Luffy the one thing...
